en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Concomitance with Consciousness (Cittānuparivattiduka).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and concomitant with consciousness, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable and non-reactive, and not concomitant with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root, three under object … pe … six under non-disappearance.
